one_line: Ahom king of early state formation in Upper Assam, credited with restoring royal authority and defining coronation and frontier traditions.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s, lean but sturdy build, athletic yet refined posture.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, warm medium-brown complexion, straight nose, sharp dark eyes with slightly thick brows, a small trimmed moustache, default expression calm and thoughtful with a hint of determined resolve.
appearance.hair: Straight, black hair pulled back into a neat topknot secured with a simple dark wooden pin, sides smoothly combed; no crown, just a slim gold forehead band with a small central red stone resting above the brows.
appearance.costume: Early Ahom royal attire inspired by Upper Assam c. 14th century: a long-sleeved, hip-length silk jacket in deep indigo blue with subtle woven geometric motifs, fastened diagonally across the chest with small gold buttons; beneath it, a soft off-white cotton tunic collar peeking at neck and cuffs; lower garment a ankle-length wrapped dhoti-like kain in muted golden-cream with thin maroon borders, pleated neatly at the front; over one shoulder and across the torso he wears a rich saffron-gold seleng (shawl) with fine red and green stripes at the edges, draped securely but allowing arm movement; simple yet dignified jewellery—small gold ear studs, a single understated gold chain with a tiny leaf-shaped pendant, and a narrow gold bracelet on his right wrist; plain leather sandals appropriate to the terrain, dark brown and sturdy.
appearance.signature: A long Ahom-style ceremonial sword with a slightly curved steel blade, a plain dark wooden hilt capped with a simple brass pommel and a modest brass guard, carried in a dark brown leather scabbard with saffron-gold cloth wrapping and worn at his left hip.

ref_desc: Sudangphaa Bamuni Konwar is a mid-30s lean Ahom king with an oval medium-brown face, black hair in a topknot and gold forehead band, wearing a deep indigo jacket, golden-cream wrap, saffron-gold shawl and dark brown sandals, carrying a curved ceremonial sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of Sudangphaa Bamuni Konwar: a dignified mid-30s Ahom king with an oval medium-brown face, sharp dark eyes, small trimmed moustache, and black hair pulled into a neat topknot held by a simple dark wooden pin, adorned only with a slim gold forehead band bearing a small central red stone. He wears an early Ahom Upper Assam royal outfit: a long-sleeved, hip-length deep indigo silk jacket with subtle woven geometric motifs, crossing diagonally and fastened by small gold buttons, with the collar and cuffs of an off-white cotton tunic softly visible underneath. His lower garment is an ankle-length wrapped golden-cream dhoti-like kain with thin maroon borders, pleated neatly in front, and over one shoulder a rich saffron-gold seleng shawl with fine red and green edge stripes drapes across his torso, arranged for both ceremony and ease of movement. Add small gold ear studs, a single simple gold chain with a tiny leaf-shaped pendant, a narrow gold bracelet on his right wrist, and sturdy dark brown leather sandals suited to Assam terrain. At his left hip hangs his signature weapon: a slightly curved ceremonial sword with a clean steel blade, plain dark wooden hilt, modest brass guard and brass pommel, sheathed in a dark brown leather scabbard partially wrapped in saffron-gold cloth. Present him front-facing, calm and thoughtful with a resolute aura, clearly showing the face, topknot, forehead band, jacket, shawl, wrap, sandals and sword, using a palette dominated by deep indigo, saffron gold, golden cream, off-white and dark brown.
